gates.evidence: Surface s03 (Starship Galley Chat) is a SFW sci-fi comedy cooking chat.
Reward is +50 credits (r1) via a 15-second game partner mini-game with no clicks or installs incentivized.
Body states 'Play a quick 15-second game to earn 50 free credits right now' using gain framing.
CTA button is clearly labeled 'Play Now' for explicit user opt-in.
Offer body explicitly states 'Play a quick 15-second game to earn 50 free credits'.
Offer includes an equally legible decline button 'No thanks'.
Trigger occurs when message credits are exhausted while chatting at zero balance boundary.
Eligibility explicitly restricts the offer to non-paying users with balance below message cost.

Appears at zero-balance boundary on s03, preserves user input and flow using SIM-RWD mini-game.

Core loop moment m1 on s03 hits free users frequently when message credits run out.
